The <b>Guardian's Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the middle-left slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Shrine Guardian Seth|Seth]] after beating all of his high scores in the [[Festival of the Flea]] games at [[Fleatopia]]. Note that Hornet tying her score with Seth's does not count as a victory.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Seth 05.png!Location in Fleatopia
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Seth 05.png!Seth in Fleatopia
}}

== Trivia ==
* The Guardian's Memento is a recoloured sprite of the [[Cut_Content_(Silksong)/Items#Materium|unused Flea Spirit Memento]], while its sprite while displayed in the Bellhome is a recoloured sprite of the unused Fleatopia Memento.

}}
